en: Old black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a two‑storey brick house with a steep tiled roof, dormer gable and chimneys, likely in a small town or village. In front of the house is an unpaved street with three blurred figures—two adults in dark clothing and one child or person in light clothing moving toward the camera. Trees and a simple wooden fence appear on the right side. The lower part of the card is mostly blank, like unused postcard space, with a handwritten number at the bottom edge.
